description_expanded: This delightful two-story home in Seagrove Beach  just on 30A exudes charm and cheer, boasting three bedrooms capable of accommodating up to eight excited beach-going guests. Its golden Americana-inspired yellow exterior, adorned with white trim, features a welcoming veranda furnished with rocking chairs that offer views of the lushly landscaped front yard. Here, you can unwind while savoring ice-cold lemonade or a frozen margarita on a balmy summer afternoon. Lion on the Beach boasts an inviting open-concept layout on the first floor, encompassing the living, dining, and kitchen areas. Adorned with comfortable rustic country-style furnishings, it features a handsome brown leather couch, a matching armchair, and three tropical accent chairs arranged to face a large flatscreen TV mounted above a beach-washed entertainment cabinet. A molasses-toned plank-top hardwood table nearby is surrounded by six colorful spindle-backed cottage chairs, creating a charming dining space. For additional seating, three wide saddle stools are positioned at a beadboard-sided quartz-topped entertainment bar overlooking the white kitchen. Equipped with custom glass-front cabinetry and brushed stainless steel appliances, the kitchen is ideal for creating fun family feasts. The luminous primary bedroom is situated on the first level. It boasts multiple windows, a king-size bed beneath an abstract waterscape painting, and a stylish royal blue crescent-shaped Vintage Modern chair. It offers access to a hall bath adorned in white-veined marble, featuring a walk-in shower. Upstairs, the two guest quarters share a full hall bath appointed with a malt-toned granite-topped vanity sink cabinet and a tub-shower combination embellished with Travertine marble tile. One of these charming sunny guest bedrooms features a queen-size bed flanked by whitewashed side tables with elegant lamps. The second guest bedroom, ideal for a small family, offers a queen-size bed and a white shutter-styled bunk with two twin beds. Between the guest bedrooms lies a cozy den with seating facing a wall-mounted flatscreen TV and glass doors leading out to a balcony. Nestled within the charming Cottages at Eastern Lake neighborhood, this snug cottage offers exclusive access to a luxurious community swimming pool complete with restroom facilities and a patio adorned with palm trees. Despite the close proximity to the beautiful beach, transportation is a breeze with a complimentary six-seater golf cart, perfect for carrying your picnic basket and cooler. Additionally, four bicycles are provided for leisurely rides. Surrounded by natural beauty, the neighborhood is adjacent to a lagoon connected to Eastern Lake , a Coastal Dune Lake known for its diverse wildlife and abundant fish population. Nearby, Deer Lake , situated along the pristine shoreline of a state beach park, is another picturesque coastal dune lake where deer can often be spotted grazing on sea oats at twilight. This incredible Seagrove Beach locale is just minutes from the captivating coastal village of Rosemary Beach to the east and Seaside to the west. Rosemary Beach boasts Dutch West Indies Colonial-styled architecture, inviting village lawns, serene fountains, lush gardens, and charming landscaping. A European-styled venue gracefully slopes down a dune toward the beach, adding to its enchanting allure. Visitors can indulge in fine dining, savor wines at bistros, unwind at friendly bars, explore fashion boutiques, peruse specialty shops, and admire fine galleries within this idyllic village. Throughout the year, Rosemary Beach hosts lively festivals on its village lawns, offering golden Americana-styled family events, outdoor concerts, and seasonal fireworks. The iconic Seaside community to the west is also a must-visit destination, known for its coastal charm and convenience. Here, guests can immerse themselves in the vibrant streets known for picturesque architecture, a bustling town center, and pristine beaches. Escape to Lion on the Beach today, your delightful 30A retreat where memories are crafted, and relaxation is the only necessary item on your agenda! First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Primary Bedroom with Shared Walk-In Shower. Second Floor: Queen Bedroom, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Queen Bedroom with Twin Bunk, Sitting Area with Balcony Access, Laundry.
